cohort: 213 near- and full-term neonates (gestational ages ≥35 weeks) diagnosed with sepsis and received meropenem
finding: Premature birth, cesarean delivery, EOS, and septic shock were independently associated with NARDS among near- and full-term septic neonates, while PCT showed limited predictive value for NARDS.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was independently associated with NARDS among near- and full-term septic neonates.
birth_weight: not specified, but infants with NARDS had a lower birth weight than those without NARDS
